name: internflow-ai
description: InternFlow AI — a multi-app AI agent that orchestrates internship applications across Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Notion and the web.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
